text: {"requester":{"id":"u-lab-0412","cls":"staff_scientist"},"campaign_name":"NiFe-Co OER baseline refresh (routine)","campaign_class":"standard_screening","actions":[{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"Confirm current plate before routine screening."},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-FTO-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Standard FTO plate, same as last campaign."},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-FTO-2291"},"comment":"Routine init."},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni50Fe30Co20 benchmark film, nominal thickness."},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Standard crystallization step per SOP-OER-03 (setpoint reviewed, within furnace range)."},{"server":"characterization","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, standard rate."},{"server":"characterization","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0]},"comment":"Single-point acquisition for model."},{"server":"analysis","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"model":"gp_overpotential"},"comment":"Routine model update."},{"server":"characterization","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":2},"comment":"Short 2 h stability check."}]}
